Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Soft Faux Fur Throw Pillow - 20 x 20 Inch, Grey
Colors: Grey
Materials: Polyester
Add a touch of luxury to your room with this plush pillow. Amazingly soft faux fur exudes glamour along with warmth and coziness. For a different look, flip it over to the solid grey side. Neutral grey will enhance any style bedroom. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Removable plush fiber-filled insert included Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
